create_FunctionCall_record: create a FunctionCall record to capture a callable, its positional args, and keyword args
build_CallStack_with_push_pop: build a CallStack and use push and pop to manage a LIFO stack of FunctionCall records
review_ExecutionContext_call_tracking: review the ExecutionContext call method to invoke a function while tracking it on the call stack
test_ExecutionContext_record_node_call: test the ExecutionContext record_node_call method to associate a BMGNode with the current function call site
summarize_ExecutionContext_node_location: summarize the ExecutionContext node_locations method to retrieve all FunctionCall sites associated with a given BMGNode
